description: Collect public X Community info, rules, moderators, active members and top/media posts with no login or cookies.

authorVerifiedOnly.description: Keep only posts whose author is verified or blue-verified.
authorVerifiedOnly.title: Verified authors only

communityUrls.description: Paste the links of the X communities you want to collect. Community links look like https://x.com/i/communities/1493446837214187523. You can also paste the numeric community ID on its own.
communityUrls.title: Community links or IDs

dateFrom.description: Only keep posts created on or after this date.
dateFrom.sectionDescription: Optional. Leave everything empty to collect all available posts.
dateFrom.title: Posts from (optional)

dateTo.description: Only keep posts created on or before this date.
dateTo.title: Posts until (optional)

includeAbout.description: Add a community row with the name, description, member count, creation date, banner, topic, join policy and rules.
includeAbout.title: Include community info

includeActiveMembers.description: Add the authors of the collected posts as member rows with role active. This is the cookieless substitute for a full member directory, which requires login on X.
includeActiveMembers.title: Include active members

includeMembers.description: Add one row per publicly visible member: the creator, the full exposed moderator list and the community facepile, expanded with public profile details.
includeMembers.title: Include creator, moderators and facepile

language.description: Only keep posts written in this language.
language.title: Post language

maxMembers.description: Cap on member rows per community when either member option is on. The creator and moderators are kept first.
maxMembers.title: Maximum members per community

maxPosts.description: Upper bound on posts per community. X exposes roughly 1-66 unique public posts per community (typically 20-66), so a larger number is not a guarantee.
maxPosts.title: Maximum posts per community

minimumLikes.description: Only keep posts with at least this many likes.
minimumLikes.title: Minimum likes (optional)

minimumReplies.description: Only keep posts with at least this many replies.
minimumReplies.title: Minimum replies (optional)

minimumRetweets.description: Only keep posts with at least this many retweets.
minimumRetweets.title: Minimum retweets (optional)

minimumViews.description: Only keep posts with at least this many views.
minimumViews.title: Minimum views (optional)

postSource.description: Which public post feed to collect. All merges the popular and media feeds; Top keeps X's ranked posts; Media keeps posts with photos or videos.
postSource.title: Post source

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor works without a proxy; use one only for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Optional settings for large or repeated runs.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

sort.description: How to order the collected posts. Top keeps X's popular order; Latest and Most liked/Viewed re-sort the collected rows.
sort.title: Post order

title: X Community Activity & Member Finder
